protocol: 3 labelled source domains + one unlabelled target; four held-target tasks in original order

arms.name: r1_shared
arms.comparison: Replay S1 with observational probes; verify final state vs original

arms.name: r3_split
arms.comparison: r3-r2 isolates separate target generator (stages + Expansion)

arms.name: r4_silu32
arms.comparison: r4-r3 replaces only stage maps with Linear-SiLU-Linear, r=32

interpretation_limits: Shared class prompt remains shared, matching original SPL; projector split does not isolate all teacher/student parameters
r=32 SiLU changes nonlinearity AND capacity/parameterization vs full linear; improvement alone cannot uniquely establish nonlinearity as the cause
One seed is a screening experiment; do not claim statistical significance
Offline target labels are used for diagnostic accuracy only and never for loss, bank, routing or model selection
Prior checkpoints retained final states only; historical trajectory comes from verified replay, not invented recovery
